description: This file defines the Kumaraswamy distribution class, including methods for computing moments, mean, mode, variance, and entropy, and imports necessary PyTorch modules.

classes.name: Kumaraswamy
classes.description: A class representing the Kumaraswamy distribution, inheriting from TransformedDistribution, with methods for distribution properties and transformations.

methods.name: _moments
methods.description: Computes the nth moment of the Kumaraswamy distribution using torch.lgamma.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a Kumaraswamy distribution instance with concentration parameters.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands the distribution parameters to a new batch shape.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: mode
methods.description: Calculates the mode of the distribution in a numerically stable way.

methods.name: variance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: entropy
methods.description: Calculates the entropy of the distribution.
